name: Percentage Calculator
summary: Calculate percentages, percent-of, percent change, and increase/decrease — in your browser.
description: Four common percentage modes: X% of Y, X is what % of Y, percent change between two values, and increase/decrease a value by a percent. All math runs locally.

faqs.question: How is percent change calculated?
faqs.answer: (new − old) / |old| × 100. A zero starting value is not allowed.

faqs.question: Can I decrease by a percent?
faqs.answer: Yes — use Increase / decrease mode and pick Decrease.

faqs.question: Is anything uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Calculations run entirely in your browser.
